title: South Australian minimum housing standards
description: Steps to make sure a rental meets the minimum housing standards under the Housing Improvement Act 2016 before the tenant moves in. The standards themselves were not read; work through the Housing Safety Authority's list.

sources.title: Tenancy reforms for landlords and agents

items.title: Read the minimum housing standards on the Housing Safety Authority website
Walk through the property and check each standard
Get quotes and fix any repairs that leave the home below a standard
Check the smoke alarms are the right type, installed correctly and working
Check pool barriers and gates are in working order
Finish the work before the tenant moves in
Record the condition on the SA inspection sheet with dated photos
Keep invoices and certificates for the work
